companyDescription: AI GPU king · Dominant H100/Blackwell AI training chips + CUDA ecosystem + data center Ethernet switch leader — picks & shovels of the AI era
priceNote: Pulled back from $200 floor; Micron-led semis surge offset by competition concerns
summary: NVIDIA remains the undisputed AI infrastructure king with $253B TTM revenue (+70.7%) and $4.74T market cap. Q2 FY2027 earnings (expected Aug 2026) are the next major catalyst, with 62 analysts at Strong Buy and $298.93 consensus PT implying 52.7% upside. The stock has found a floor around $200 and Blackwell GPU demand continues to outpace supply.

catalysts.name: Q2 FY2027 Earnings
catalysts.description: Next earnings expected late August 2026. Revenue expected to continue accelerating on Blackwell GPU ramp. Q1 FY2027 beat raised the bar — another beat would push toward $230+.

catalysts.name: Blackwell GB200 NVL72 Ramp
catalysts.description: Full-rack GB200 NVL72 systems ramping through H2 2026. Hyperscalers (MSFT, META, AMZN, GOOG) committed to multi-year capex programs. Demand still >supply.

catalysts.name: China Export / Jensen AGM Comments
catalysts.description: Jensen Huang at AGM Jun 24 called black-market data centers 'a dead end'. Export ban creates TAM ceiling but NVIDIA is focused on $900B+ accessible market outside China.

risks: China export restrictions cap ~$15-20B TAM; black market chips showing NVDA is leaving revenue on the table
Competition heating up: Qualcomm announcing custom AI chips, AMD MI300X gaining hyperscaler adoption
Valuation: Forward PE 20x is reasonable but revenue estimates may get revised down if capex slowdown hits
FOMC July 29 + Big Tech earnings July 27-31 = highest volatility week of Q3 — may cause 10-15% swing

estimateDates.note: Blackwell ramp revenue read + Q3 guidance key
FOMC Jul 29 + MSFT/META/AMZN/GOOGL earnings = macro risk window

macroRisk.rateOutlook: FOMC July 29 — market pricing 70% hold, 30% hike. PCE 3.6% = sticky inflation keeps hike risk on table.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Services inflation remains elevated. Fed needs 2-3 more months of softening data before cutting. No cuts in 2026 now base case for most desks.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: MEDIUM impact for NVDA. High valuations in semis are rate-sensitive, but NVDA's earnings visibility (locked in capex commitments) reduces sensitivity vs. pure-growth names. A hike would likely cause a 10-15% correction but not break the thesis.
macroRisk.summary: Fed risk is MEDIUM. NVDA's structural AI infrastructure role insulates it from mild rate hikes, but the July 27-31 window (FOMC + Big Tech earnings) is the highest risk period. Accumulate NOW or wait until early August post-FOMC clarity.

entryStrategy.verdict: Core Holding — small size now, add at $178-185 post-FOMC. Target $270-299 by year-end.

catalystSpot.preRunup: NVDA historically runs 10-18% in the 3-4 weeks before earnings as buy-the-rumor positioning builds. After Q4 FY2025 (Feb 2025) beat, stock ran +15% pre-earnings then added another +8% post-beat.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: 3-4 สัปดาห์ก่อน earnings (early-mid August)

postWin.note: NVDA Q4 FY2025 (Feb 2025) beat consensus by 14% — stock +8.7% next session. Q1 FY2026 (May 2025) beat by 11% — stock +5.2%. Q3 FY2025 (Nov 2024) — beat + raised guidance — stock +24% over 2 weeks.

postLose.note: NVDA Q2 FY2024 (Aug 2023) — beat but guidance disappointed vs high expectations — stock -6% initially before recovering. Data center miss scenario could trigger -12-15%.

spotSizing.reason: High conviction, 62-analyst Strong Buy consensus, but elevated valuation and macro headwinds limit size. 8% of portfolio pre-earnings; can scale to 15% post-FOMC if entry at $178-185.

comparableCases.event: Q3 FY2025 Earnings Beat + Blackwell Ramp Guide
comparableCases.note: Beat by 10%, raised guidance on Blackwell ramp — stock ran +24% over 2 weeks. Template for upcoming Q2 FY2027 if Blackwell demand exceeds expectations.
Semi peers with high AI GPU expectations delivered +15-20% post-beat. Shows the sector re-rates strongly on confirmed demand.
Tripled Q2 revenue guidance — stock +25% in 3 days. Blackwell upgrade cycle could deliver similar if ramp exceeds $45B+ quarterly guide.
